verdicts.reason: Both use the same leaderboard layout with the same flaws: the logo is jammed against the left edge and nearly touches the headline, the SAVE badge floats above the body copy, separated from the offer it belongs to, and the coffee bag is shrunk to an unreadable sliver at the right edge. A keeps the CTA button and badge at a strong size, so the action stands out. In B the CTA is smaller and weaker, the badge looks cramped against the body copy, and the hierarchy is flatter overall.
